omar: Heads-up Customer 'Atlas Compliance' wants deeper evidence for KMS rotation cadence and an example of SIEM query that pulls tenant-level KMS events.
lena: We should give them the KQL sample used by our SOC: `SecurityEvent | where Source == "KMS" and EventTime > ago(30d) and TenantId == "TENANT-REDACTED"` with a note to swap tenant id.
legal: No tenant IDs in the bundle. Use TENANT-REDACTED.
sec-bot: created SEC-3377 assigned to omar,lena.
omar: I'll add a 1-paragraph explanation of rotation policy: monthly rotation for service keys, emergency rotation within 24-48h post-detection.
lena: Also include sample rotation job output (redacted) and the cron job entry.
sec-bot: evidence_atlas_5059870001.tar.gz uploaded by lena at 2026-03-21T10:02:01Z.
